summary: Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A. (AMPSA) filed a 6-K incorporating a press release noting that its controlling shareholder, Ardagh Holdings S.A. (AHSA), amended its Schedule 13D to disclose plans to explore a potential sale of AMPSA. AHSA instructed advisers to prepare for a possible sale of some or all of its equity interests in AMPSA to a third party, potentially including a scenario where AHSA first acquires outstanding AMPSA shares to facilitate a full sale. Evercore is financial adviser and Kirkland & Ellis legal adviser. No timeline, pricing, or certainty of a transaction; services agreement with AHSA may terminate, adding ~$30M annual standalone cost. Watch for board approval and risk-arb on potential tender offer.
